npcs.name: Major Cassian Vorn
npcs.status: Not physically present — last remote contact during the post-Vannix debrief; expected to make contact again.
npcs.summary: The Imperial officer holding coercive authority over the party's collars and running the mission's clean-up operation.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Assigned Mission 02 as a hard, non-negotiable order. Assumes the party still has evidence from Vannix and said he'd revisit that matter "later, and less politely." Controls the collars and holds classified mission credentials.

npcs.name: Colonel Doran Rennick
npcs.role: Imperial Army Garrison Commander, Cathal's Reach
npcs.status: Present at the garrison — not yet directly encountered by the party.
npcs.summary: The party's Mission 02 target: a weathered garrison commander known for calm, dry humor, and genuine care for his soldiers.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Known so far only through the mission briefing as the assigned target. Reputation from the briefing: after a rebel ambush killed several of his soldiers, he refused a doctrinal reprisal massacre and personally hunted the responsible cell instead, leaving the town standing — something Command apparently read as disobedience.

npcs.name: Captain Ilse Wove
npcs.status: Present — arrived at the party's logger's house the morning after the cantina brawl, with two troopers, asking for Eleena Daru by name.
npcs.summary: Rennick's fiercely loyal second — watchful, blunt, and unimpressed by outsiders.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Come in person, controlled and patient, using implied knowledge rather than force. The cantina brawl clearly reached her overnight. Hasn't drawn a weapon or threatened the house. What she actually knows versus is fishing for isn't established yet.

npcs.name: Master Sergeant Bant Corrl
npcs.status: Off-screen, at the wrecked Redfall cantina — openly hostile after the brawl.
npcs.summary: Warm, loud, and beloved by his troops — runs the cantina culture and knows every soldier by name.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Was warmly charmed by Eleena at the cantina, then turned hostile once the ID-sweep officers were killed — fired twice on Vesh, the second shot scoring a Critical Injury. Didn't pursue when constabulary arrived. Relationship with the party, especially Eleena, is severely damaged.

npcs.name: Marn Oshel
npcs.status: Unknown — helped the party the night of the cantina brawl, then left.
npcs.summary: A weathered backcountry local who helped carry Vesh clear of the cantina wreckage.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Remarked flatly that the party "doesn't fight like surveyors" and left without answering questions. Purpose and allegiance unknown.

npcs.name: Old Maera Tannis
npcs.summary: A homesteader whose family Rennick's troops protected instead of executing during the reprisal order.

npcs.summary: Key witness from the Vannix operation.
npcs.whatPartyKnows: Her whereabouts and status since the escape from the Core are unknown.

locations.name: Cathal's Reach
locations.summary: Imperial-garrisoned world, current mission setting. Home to Redfall Station and the backcountry beyond it. Held under Colonel Doran Rennick's unusually restrained command.

locations.name: Redfall Station
locations.summary: Spaceport and logging/timber town on Cathal's Reach; the party's base of operations under cover as an independent surveying outfit. Currently unsettled after the cantina brawl — the party is lying low at a borrowed logger's house on the edge of town.

locations.name: Sure Thing
locations.summary: Z-95-AF4 Headhunter, formerly Vesh's assigned personal craft. Long lost — reassigned or impounded by Kordyne well before this mission. No longer accessible to the party.

locations.name: Mournful Credit
locations.summary: The staged freighter used to insert the party into Vannix Station on Mission 01. Crashed and burned during the escape from the wreck — no longer exists.
